segments.title: AI & Computer Vision
segments.script: My focus then shifted to making systems intelligent, particularly through computer vision. For the Post Office Analyser, I used YOLO for object detection and OpenCV to define spatial corridors, enabling real-time queue analytics, counter occupancy, and service time estimation. In the Football Analyser, I integrated YOLO for player detection, ByteTrack for multi-object tracking, K-Means for team assignment based on jersey colors, and Optical Flow with homography to calculate real-time player speed, distance covered, and pitch possession. I also developed the Cafe Analyser and Classroom Analyser, applying similar vision-based techniques for activity and interaction monitoring.

segments.title: Major AI Products
segments.script: These experiments matured into comprehensive AI products. AL-AQL is my 100% offline multimodal assistant. I built its Flutter frontend and Python/llama.cpp backend, leveraging TinyLLaMA 1.1B, quantized to 4-bit NF4, shrinking its footprint from 4.1GB to about 590MB for zero-cloud local execution. I used LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, RAG with LlamaIndex and ChromaDB for knowledge retrieval, and integrated Stable Diffusion with ControlNet for offline image generation, all orchestrated via my Model Context Protocol. Weaver AI is a generative application engine using FastAPI and Gemini to synthesize full-stack web applications from natural language, offering live previews and iterative code refinement. Smart Classroom Assist, a Smart India Hackathon 2024 winner, uses Flutter, Python, YOLOv11, MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Gemini for automated attendance, lecture board capture, and interactive animations. I also developed RouteX Capital for financial route analytics and MarketNOW, an AI-powered Generative Engine Optimization platform.

segments.title: Application Development & Experiments Montage
segments.script: Beyond these core platforms, I've explored diverse applications and conducted various experiments. This includes Mahdaviat, a community digital platform, an Offline AI Chatbot, and PatrolPro, a smart city system for pothole and animal conflict detection. My experimental work ranges from an AI Drawing Challenge to Blender Automation using my Model Context Protocol, demonstrating my continuous exploration of AI's practical applications and my ability to integrate complex systems.
